metadata.title: MV Trainer
metadata.author: huynd2210
metadata.description:
Resource and repair cheats for FTL: Multiverse, on F4-F10.
F4 fully heal - hull to max, all your crew to full health F5 +100 scrap F6 +1000 scrap F7 refill fuel to 30 F8 refill missiles to 30 F9 refill drone parts to 30 F10 refill fuel, missiles and drone parts
F11 and F12 are deliberately left alone (fullscreen toggle, Steam screenshot).
Requires Hyperspace. Patch this BELOW the Multiverse files, since it adds its script to the <scripts> block that Multiverse's hyperspace.xml provides.
Hotkeys are ignored while jumping and while an event or menu box is open, but do work during the normal tactical pause.
